run_process_mlrs: run the script to process ML relaxation trajectories and group configs by adsorbate-surface system
run_min_diff: run the min_diff function to compare atom positions between initial and final structures with PBC
run_process_mlrs_single: run the process_mlrs function to detect anomalies and extract relaxed energy for a single trajectory
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse CLI arguments for ML trajectory processing including ml-trajs-path and outdir
run_main: run the main block to process all ML trajectories in parallel and save sorted configs and anomalies to pickle files
